semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Drees & Sommer SE is involved in the design and construction of semiconductor fabrication facilities, which are critical to the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Drees & Sommer SE provides specialized services in the design, planning, construction, and commissioning of semiconductor fabrication facilities. They offer comprehensive project lifecycle support, including site selection and realization, with expertise in European building standards and approval processes.
capabilities: Design and planning of semiconductor fabs
Construction and commissioning of high-tech facilities

regional_presence.Europe: Drees & Sommer SE has extensive experience with European building standards and approval processes, including the German Federal Emission Control Act (BImSchG).
